recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit in core. Follow up in the FHIR Extension Pack to decide whether capabilitystatement-prohibited should be aligned with the current capabilitystatement-expectation context list or intentionally remain narrower.
issue_request: FHIR-28103 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core R4 change request applied for R5. It requested additional capabilitystatement-expectation contexts for CapabilityStatement.rest.resource, CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.extension for capabilitystatement-search-parameter-combination, CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.operation, CapabilityStatement.format, CapabilityStatement.patchFormat, CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.supportedProfile, and matching alignment for capabilitystatement-prohibited.
initial_application: FHIR-I approved the request on 2020-07-27. Core commit ca6580aa55fdeefe3f87891deeeed8c4bbcbc2f6 added CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.extension to source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-extension-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml; the other requested expectation contexts were already present in that R5 source file. The historical core source did not receive a matching capabilitystatement-prohibited context update.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the capabilitystatement-expectation and capabilitystatement-prohibited StructureDefinition XML files from source/capabilitystatement when extension definitions moved out of core. The current authoritative Extension Pack source and published JSON include the requested expectation contexts, including the later FHIR-34397 search-parameter-combination extension context, but capabilitystatement-prohibited still has only its older narrower context list. Later FHIR-extensions issues FHIR-46192 and FHIR-56196 adjusted capabilitystatement-expectation contexts without updating capabilitystatement-prohibited.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was changed. The remaining source-of-truth work, if the prohibited alignment from FHIR-28103 is still desired, must be evaluated and applied in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than this core checkout.
